findings.title: Envelope extension bypass can replace raw evidence with metadata
findings.description: The shared reader recognizes compact envelopes only when their reference ends in .json. evidence_exists likewise accepts non-JSON regular blobs without decoding, and audit only recognizes .json envelopes. A compact manifest copied to a .log path therefore satisfies evidence availability and the prospective budget despite its payload being absent, bypassing payload integrity and tested/command/exit bindings. M3 consumes these undecoded metadata bytes as a raw log, allowing a metadata string to supply its positive execution count. This violates EVIDENCE_STORAGE_POLICY.md's missing-payload fail-closed guarantee and M3_CLOSURE_CONTRACT.md's raw execution proof requirement.
findings.required_change: Recognize compact signatures independently of the extension, or reject renamed compact records in shared read, availability, and budget paths. Preserve historical genuine plain evidence. Add regressions covering .log/.txt aliases with absent or corrupt payloads, mismatched tested/command/exit metadata, and metadata-only pytest counts.
